description: H2 excited states, RPA, the lowest root at one rung (protocol 1e-4, k 6) plus static alpha_zz. excited.num_states is 1 so the case fits the medium tier; the same deck at 2 roots gave the identical omega_0 to 1e-13. The response block sets dconv 1e-4 explicitly: left unset it derives to 100*thresh = 0.01, and since the FD/ES gates ride at 5*dconv that 5e-2 gate let the RPA root stop at bsh 1.1e-2 -- an omega 5.0e-4 away from this reference, half the asserted 1e-3 tolerance, so the old number was one solver nudge from a red. At dconv 1e-4 the gates are 5e-4: 9 envelope iterations, the FD leg at bsh 2.3e-6 and the ES root at bsh 2.9e-5 / density 2.0e-4 after 9 ES iterations. Reference: RelWithDebInfo, TBB, 1 rank x 7 threads, Seawulf Milan long-96core-shared, 2026-09-21, commit 80e89f829 (job 2193426), wall 24 s. omega tol 1e-3 au.
